:::{#thm-var-logodds}

#### Variance of the estimated log-odds

In a [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression),
let $\eb$ be the [maximum likelihood estimate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) of $\vb$,
let $\Sigma \eqdef \Covt(\eb)$ be its covariance matrix,
and let $\hat\logodds(\vx) = \dprodf{\vx}{\eb}$ be the estimated log-odds at covariate pattern $\vx$.
Then:

$$\Var{\hat\logodds(\vx)} = \tp{\vx}\Sigma\vx$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-se-logodds, worked in @sol-se-logodds.

:::
